threat_event: Stolen partner-operator session used to run commands across managed-hosting tenants
threat_source: Cybercriminal or state-sponsored group using adversary-in-the-middle phishing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing partner-operator access federated from the Managed IT legacy tenant; push MFA; 12-hour sessions not bound to a device; no run-command volume alert
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H1 HCP run-command; about 4,100 managed-hosting tenants
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4); N54-R06 (164.308); N52-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); customer agreement
existing_controls: SYS-G1 hardware keys for Cloud Hosting staff; run-command audit logs; EDR on engineer laptops
treatment_plan: Move partner-operator access to SYS-G1 PAM with hardware keys and per-client scope; 1-hour device-bound sessions; run-command volume alert (POAM-001, POAM-002)

threat_event: Malicious script pushed through the single RMM tenant reaches client servers, Payment Processing connected-to servers, and the CUI enclave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One RMM tenant for all clients and internal uses; multi-client scripts need one approver; agents on settlement-support and enclave management servers
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M1; client systems; SYS-P1 connected-to segment; SYS-M2
existing_controls: Named RMM accounts; EDR on most client servers; script library in version control
treatment_plan: Two-person approval for multi-client scripts; separate internal tooling for Payment Processing and SYS-M2; RMM logs to the SIEM (POAM-013, POAM-014, POAM-015)

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, agency, bank, client, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No single notification matrix; never exercised; bank-designated contacts incomplete (70% Cloud Hosting, 64% Managed IT); PAIN procedure untested
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 matrix; collect bank contacts; cross-division tabletop on 2026-12-09 (POAM-004, POAM-005)

threat_event: AI triage service auto-closes a true positive or runs a disruptive containment action in another division
threat_source: AI model error or adversarial manipulation of alert content
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-close of about 64% of alerts without validation by division; 7 unattended SOAR actions; seeded test missed 3 of 40
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G2; every division environment including G1 and the CDE
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (MAS-CSO-TPR); PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 10; N54-R05 (3.14.6)
existing_controls: Analyst review of High-severity alerts; SOAR action logging
treatment_plan: Human approval for containment in G1 and the CDE from 2026-10-15; quarterly seeded tests per division; auto-close limits (POAM-003; P10)

threat_event: G1 loses its FedRAMP certification because the 2026 rules are not adopted by their grace dates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy POA&M and continuous monitoring model; no PAIN procedure test; MAS scope excludes shared services; no SDR or trust center
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H1 G1 partition; SL-2 revenue; 27 agencies; about 140 DIB customers
sp800_53_controls: CA-5; CA-7; RA-5; CM-8; PL-2; SC-13
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (VDR; VER; IEC; MAS; CMU; SCN; CCM; SDR; CDS)
existing_controls: Annual independent assessment; monthly deliverables; Government Cloud compliance director
treatment_plan: Funded transition program by ruleset date (P03 roadmap; POAM-005 to POAM-011)

threat_event: Managed IT loses DoD subcontract work and DIB clients because CMMC Level 2 and ESP duties are not ready
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 110 requirements not fully met; SPRS assessment expires 2027-02-12; no ESP responsibility matrix; no C3PAO engaged
existing_controls: CUI enclave; 2024 basic self-assessment
treatment_plan: Close the 14 requirements; new assessment and SPRS score; engage a C3PAO; ESP responsibility matrix (POAM-021, POAM-022)

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared identity and the landing zone to several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and landing zone connect all divisions
existing_controls: EDR everywhere; immutable vault at external provider X; PAM
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests across divisions; segmentation reviews in the hub network

threat_event: Payment Processing relies on two affiliates without contractual safeguards or a PCI DSS responsibility matrix
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intercompany agreement with 314.4(f) terms; responsibility matrix covers group services only; connected-to servers out of scope description
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-P1; PCI DSS compliance; FTC Safeguards program
existing_controls: Group-services responsibility matrix; annual ROC
treatment_plan: Intercompany agreements with Cloud Hosting and Managed IT; full responsibility matrix; scope update (POAM-018, POAM-019)

threat_event: Correlated failure across SL-1 regions takes down the CDE, the RMM, and corporate workloads together
threat_source: Fleet-wide faulty update or control plane defect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CDE active-active design assumes R1 and R3 fail independently; no shared failure mode test
regulatory_driver: N52-R03; card network and sponsor bank terms; C-IT-R05
existing_controls: Staged rollouts; region-by-region deployment waves
treatment_plan: Shared failure mode exercise; deployment wave rules that never touch R1 and R3 the same day (POAM-012)

threat_event: Compromise of the software supply chain pushes a malicious guest-agent update to customer VMs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: A single signing service reaches every customer VM through fleet automation
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H3; customer VMs across SL-1 and G1
existing_controls: HSM-held keys; two-person release; reproducible builds
treatment_plan: Separate G1 signing domain review; canary verification of agent behavior before fleet-wide rollout

threat_event: Insider misuses privileged access across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many privileged roles across three divisions
existing_controls: PAM; session recording; background checks
treatment_plan: Insider risk analytics for privileged users

threat_event: Staff follow outdated division standards that are weaker than group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Managed IT supplement last aligned 2024 (push MFA, 12-hour sessions, 90-day RMM log retention)
existing_controls: Group policy governs in conflicts (POL-01 4.5)
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Managed IT supplement; annual attestation (POAM-016)
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Clients and assessors cannot see which Managed IT controls come from the group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance not documented for Managed IT
existing_controls: Common control catalog exists
treatment_plan: Managed IT inheritance matrix (POAM-017)
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A covered person gains access to bulk U.S. sensitive personal data or government-related data through a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support vendors screened for sanctions but not covered-person status
affected_asset_or_process: Support tickets and logs (G1, SL-1, payments)
existing_controls: Sanctions screening; U.S.-only access to G1
treatment_plan: Covered-person screening in vendor onboarding and annual review (POAM-020)

threat_event: Alert context sent to the third-party model service exposes G1 metadata or customer data
threat_source: Model service provider breach or misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model service not documented as a FedRAMP third-party resource; data minimization not applied
existing_controls: Contract with no-training and no-retention terms
treatment_plan: Minimize and redact alert context; document as third-party resource (POAM-008; P10)

threat_event: The disclosure committee decides materiality late or inconsistently for a cross-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality criteria do not yet weigh FedRAMP certification, bank, and DIB effects
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity
treatment_plan: Add cross-division factors to the materiality worksheet; exercise in the tabletop

threat_event: A critical third party (identity SaaS, SIEM, RMM vendor) suffers an outage or breach affecting several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration on a few SaaS vendors used by all divisions
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 reviews; break-glass accounts
treatment_plan: Tier 1 vendor continuous monitoring; contractual incident notice within 24 hours for tier 1 vendors

threat_event: Hurricane or flooding affects the Florida headquarters and region R1 data centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: R1 and headquarters in Florida
affected_asset_or_process: BP-H01 (R1); BP-P01 (R1 half of the CDE)
existing_controls: Multi-region design; CDE active in R3; generators with 72-hour fuel
treatment_plan: Accepted: multi-region design covers the loss of R1

threat_event: AI models in division products make unfair, unsafe, or unexplained decisions about customers, merchants, or consumers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division models predate the Group AI Standard (2026-04-20); bias testing incomplete
regulatory_driver: FTC Act Sec. 5; Colorado SB26-189 (watch); card network rules
existing_controls: Group AI council; model risk reviews in Payment Processing
treatment_plan: Group AI program conditions (P10)

threat_event: Shortage of U.S.-person staff limits G1 operations and incident response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: G1 staffing restricted to U.S. persons by design
existing_controls: Hiring pipeline; cross-trained commercial staff who qualify
treatment_plan: Expand G1 on-call pool by 20%
